name: authoritygraph
description: Read-only authority and permission analysis for Solana protocols

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @authoritygraph/api" "npm run dev -w @authoritygraph/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @authoritygraph/api && npm run build -w @authoritygraph/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @authoritygraph/api && npm run typecheck -w @authoritygraph/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @authoritygraph/api && npm run test -w @authoritygraph/web
